component.name: PrintLayout
component.summary: Print photos several to a page or save them as PDF

description.p: PrintLayout places photos on a sheet in a grid — one full page, 2 × 2, 3 × 3 or any number of rows and columns — and prints the result or saves it as a PDF.

ul.li: Automatic arrangement in list order, or manual placement by drag and drop
A4, A3, A5 and 10 × 15 / 13 × 18 photo paper, portrait or landscape
Adjustable margins and gaps, fit or crop, automatic rotation and cut lines
Projects can be saved and opened again later
